title: Dry January Slip Pattern by Weekday
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:alcohol
| search challenge="dry_january" event_type="drink"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as slip_events by _time weekday
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Dry January slips over time and breaks it out by weekday.
value: Weekday patterning helps you see whether the challenge is failing from routine stress or social weekends.
implementation: Send Dry January slips events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Dry January slips by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how Dry January slips changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
